notes: Verified: internal/store/approvals.go single-statement data-modifying CTE is atomic; UPDATE WHERE status='PENDING_REVIEW' is re-evaluated after the row lock (READ COMMITTED EvalPlanQual), so it correctly serializes with the reviewer path in internal/platformapi/mutate_operations.go:349 (FOR UPDATE + status recheck) and the execute path in internal/runtimeapi/approval.go (only APPROVED rows, expires_at rechecked). Schema allows NULL actor_user_id on both qurio_approval_events and qurio_audit_logs; no inner JOIN on actor in readers.

Verified: the new integration test really exercises the target — ran it against a throwaway postgres:16 (-race), PASS in 1.4s; it asserts exact status/decided_at/event/audit rows, idempotency of a second sweep, and the lock-contention case (sweep blocks while reviewer holds FOR UPDATE, then yields to REJECTED). go build ./... and go vet -tags=integration pass. CI runs -tags=integration ./... with -p=1 so the test will execute there.

Minor fragility: approvals_integration_test.go:87 and :137 assert exact counts (len(expired)==2, second sweep==0) against a shared DB; any leftover PENDING_REVIEW row with a past expires_at from an aborted earlier test would fail it. Existing tests do clean up, so acceptable.

Behavioral nuance: cmd/qurio/main.go cleanupExpired uses a 1h ticker with no initial run, so after a restart overdue requests remain PENDING_REVIEW up to an hour until the first sweep (same as existing cleanup tasks). Not a defect but the admin-guide wording 'hourly' is accurate.
Small divergence from 'same event' wording: sweep writes details {"source":"scheduler"} while the reviewer path writes '{}'. Reasonable and useful for distinguishing origin; not a correctness issue.

The sweep does not take the qurio.platform.authorization advisory xact lock that withTransaction() uses; the row lock is sufficient for this transition and the sweep does not touch authorization data.
Reversible: no migration, no external state; revert removes the sweep cleanly. Scope is tight (feature + doc + test only).
